observation.visible_scene: A wide, eye-level landscape shot of a rugged, partly snow-capped mountain range occupying the upper half of the frame, mirrored almost perfectly in a glassy, dark-green lake that fills the lower half. A thin horizontal shoreline separates the real mountains from their reflection. In the immediate foreground at the bottom are tufts of dry golden grass, and at the lower left a dense cluster of dark evergreen trees with a few bare pale branches. The sky above the ridge is flat and overcast-white.
visible_changes: The composition is static throughout the excerpt: the mountain ridgeline, the snow patches, the shoreline, the foreground grass, and the left-side trees hold the same pixel positions from the first to the last sampled frame.
The lake surface and its reflection show no visible ripples, distortion, or shifting highlights; the mirror image of the mountains remains unchanged frame to frame.
No object (tree, grass, cloud, water feature) translates, deforms, appears, or disappears within the segment; the only 'process' is the sustained stillness of the scene.
outside_clip_unknowns: Any wind gust, water disturbance, or camera motion that may occur before t=0 or after t=1.333 s is outside this crop and cannot be assessed.
The reason the lake is so calm (absence of wind) is inferred from appearance only, not shown as a cause.
uncertain_details: Sub-pixel camera drift or minute changes in the reflection texture cannot be reliably distinguished between adjacent frames, so the shot is treated as fully static.
